source: Czechia 26/selects/Prague (449 from the 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8 Jul culls and the Malá Strana re-cull)

places.prague-26: 2–8 Jul 2026, Prague, five days: Vinohrady and Žižkov, then Riegrovy sady at sunset (2 Jul); Hradčany, the castle, Malá Strana and Kampa, Charles Bridge and the Old Town at golden hour into the night (3 Jul); the Old Town Hall tower, Josefov and the river under grey cloud, the castle at blue hour, the Old Town and the bridge at night (5 Jul); Karlín, Vrtba garden, Čertovka, the narrow lane, Letná (6 Jul, grey); Vyšehrad, Charles Bridge at noon, the Strahov library (8 Jul)

notes.twins 6885 > 6876: 6885 wins: the towers in the last copper light fill the frame, the white gables below as a pale base, nothing else; 6876 (posted, Malá Strana #2) has the square's crowd as a dark band and the towers already losing the sun; both stay shortlisted, the posted frame to check at size
notes.twins 6925 > 6903: 6925 wins: the lit castle against blue, the statue warm-lit on the left as a counterweight, reflections in the water; 6903 is earlier, the castle not yet lit, the statue a black cut-out against pink, cleaner but the subject is dark; held, not shortlisted
notes.twins 6944 > 6942: 6944 wins: the statue and the parapet make a diagonal that leads into the frame, the river below carries the reflections; 6942 is the horizontal with the lamp and a statue small, the castle further off; the lamp is pretty, the frame is weaker; held
notes.twins 6915 > 6908: 6915 wins: wider water, the reflections of the lamps lie as a row of gold strokes across the blue, the buildings sit in the top third; 6908 is tighter on the water tower with a café crowd and a no-entry sign at the waterline, busier; held

notes.twins 7156 > 7136: 7156 wins: the cloud is heavier and darker over the spires, the towers stand against it, the grey earns its place; 7136's sky is a pale even grey; held
notes.twins 7189 > 7192: 7189 wins: the lamp and statue at the left edge, the bridge parapet leading in, the castle centred under a textured grey sky, the boat for scale: the grey works because the sky has structure; 7192 is tighter and the castle bigger but the frame is all Kampa's roofs and a café, the parapet a dark block bottom left; held

notes.twins 7652 > 7650: 7652 wins: the path curves in from the bastion at bottom left, the roofs step back to the castle on the horizon under cumulus; 7650 is a wall of trees and one roof with a skyline; held
notes.held: Candidates from the sheet (not 2★) left off the shortlist to keep the close look near 1.5× a final set. Not rejected and not viewed at size; session B may pull any of them, and should for a chapter that runs short. The twin losers in groups are held the same way.
notes.priors: Cull 'prior' frames (old selection or posted) and the Malá Strana re-cull's recoveries are evidence, not passes: every one is either shortlisted or settled side by side in a twins image (twinnotes).

The cull notes name the recovered frames. Run 2 is blind to the first pass's files, not to these.
